register.access_notes: 13 fetches, one page at a time, spaced well over 2 seconds apart (each fetch was a separate sequential request). Hebrew Wikisource (he.wikisource.org) served every page requested with no block, no 403/429 and no bot challenge: 12 pages fetched successfully (National Insurance, Provident Funds, Income Support, National Health Insurance, Income Tax Ordinance, Income Tax withholding Regulations, Customs Ordinance, Customs Tariff and Exemption Ordinance 1937, Customs Tariffs and Excise (Variation of Tariff) Law, Customs Tariff Order 2017, Taxes (Collection) Ordinance, VAT Law, Retirement Age Law, Copyright Act). The Knesset legislation database was tried twice for the same item (main.knesset.gov.il/Activity/Legislation/Laws/Pages/LawPrimary.aspx?lawitemid=2000198, then the same URL with &t=lawlaws&st=lawlaws): both returned an EMPTY page, not an error, not a 403 and not a CAPTCHA - those pages render their content client-side, so a plain fetch yields nothing. No workaround was attempted. Consequently the Knesset 'lawitemid' numbers recorded below are the ids that the Wikisource metadata box prints as its link to the Knesset database, not values read off a Knesset page, and official_url is omitted throughout rather than guessed. Israel has no free official consolidated register: the official text of each of these Acts is the original Reshumot publication plus every amending Act, so the Wikisource consolidation is the only practical consolidated Hebrew text and is NOT official.

licence.summary: No copyright subsists in Israeli statutes or regulations: Copyright Act, 5768-2007 (חוק זכות יוצרים, התשס״ח–2007), s 6 (פרסומים רשמיים / 'Official publications') provides that notwithstanding s 4 there is no copyright in laws, regulations, Knesset proceedings, or judicial decisions of a court or of any governmental authority exercising a judicial power under law. Statutory text is therefore freely reusable. The Wikisource consolidation itself is additionally published under CC BY-SA, but the underlying statutory text carries no copyright to begin with.
licence.attribution: Statutory text: Reshumot (Sefer HaChukim), State of Israel - no copyright under Copyright Act, 5768-2007, s 6. Consolidated working text read from ספר החוקים הפתוח on Hebrew Wikisource (unofficial), CC BY-SA.
licence.quote: על אף הוראות סעיף 4, לא תהא זכות יוצרים בחוקים, בתקנות, בדברי הכנסת ובהחלטות שיפוטיות של בית משפט או של כל רשות שלטונית המפעילה סמכות שפיטה על פי דין.

Israel.language_authenticity: Hebrew is authoritative; English translations are unofficial. The Mandate-era Ordinances (פקודות) were originally enacted in English but the operative texts today are the Hebrew New Versions (נוסח חדש) published in דיני מדינת ישראל, which are the authoritative texts.

acts.title: National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version], 5755-1995
acts.identifier: ס״ח תשנ״ה, 210 (further publication at ס״ח תשנ״ה, 327); Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000198; Wikisource page חוק הביטוח הלאומי
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page חוק הביטוח הלאומי. Its heading prints the title as חוק הביטוח הלאומי [נוסח משולב], התשנ״ה–1995. The metadata box gives the first Sefer HaChukim citations as 'ס״ח תשנ״ה, 210' and 'ס״ח תשנ״ה, 327' and links to Knesset lawitemid 2000198. The page states the consolidated version was made on 3 April 1995 (ג׳ בניסן התשנ״ה), replacing the National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version], 5728-1968 and the National Insurance Law [Temporary Provision], 5751-1991, and that it took effect on 1 October 1995 (ז׳ בתשרי התשנ״ו). The amendment list runs from 1954 through to תשפ״ו (2026), i.e. the consolidation is maintained to the current Hebrew year.
acts.notes: This is the single most important Israeli social-security statute and it carries BOTH sides of the system: insurance contributions (דמי ביטוח) and the benefit branches (old-age and survivors, disability, work injury, maternity, unemployment, children, long-term care, income-related supplements). It is therefore listed twice, once under Pensions/social security and once under Government benefits, as the instructions direct. It is a Knesset Law in consolidated-version form, not an Ordinance. Note that a 'נוסח משולב' (consolidated version) is itself an enacted official text, unlike the Wikisource consolidation. The Law is heavily amended and carries many temporary provisions (הוראת שעה); anyone encoding it must fix a point-in-time date.

acts.title: Supervision of Financial Services (Provident Funds) Law, 5765-2005
acts.title_he: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס״ה–2005
acts.identifier: ס״ח תשס״ה, 889; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000505; Wikisource page חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל)
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס״ה–2005; metadata box gives ס״ח תשס״ה, 889 and Knesset lawitemid 2000505. The amendment list runs to תשפ״ו, 912 (2026), and the page also notes an updating notice for indexed amounts at י״פ תשפ״ה, 9555, so the consolidation is current to the 5786 year.
acts.notes: This is the operative statute for the second (occupational/private) pension pillar: pension funds, provident funds and managing companies, licensing, and the Commissioner of Capital Markets, Insurance and Savings. It pairs with the Supervision of Financial Services (Insurance) Law and the Supervision of Financial Services (Pension Advice, Pension Marketing and Clearing System) Law, 5765-2005, which were enacted alongside it - the pillar is split across that trio, and only the Provident Funds Law is indexed here. Mandatory occupational pension coverage itself is imposed not by statute but by a general extension order (צו הרחבה) under the Collective Agreements Law; that is a labour-law instrument, flagged here because a reader will expect to find compulsory pension in the statute and will not.

acts.title: Retirement Age Law, 5764-2004
acts.identifier: ס״ח תשס״ד, 150; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000147; Wikisource page חוק גיל פרישה
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק גיל פרישה, התשס״ד–2004; metadata gives ס״ח תשס״ד, 150 and Knesset lawitemid 2000147; last amendment noted תשפ״ב (2022). Section headings read: s 3 retirement age (גיל פרישה), s 4 mandatory retirement age (גיל פרישת חובה), s 5 early retirement age (גיל פרישה מוקדמת). Section 33 and the amendment schedule cross-refer to the National Insurance Law, 5755-1995 (ss 158, 160, 166, 171, 269א).
acts.notes: This is the statute that fixes the retirement ages on which both National Insurance old-age pension and occupational pension entitlements turn, so it is a necessary companion to the two above. The women's retirement age is on a legislated gradual rise (the תשפ״א/תשפ״ב amendments); an encoding must therefore be date-parameterised by year of birth, not a single number. Sections 3-5 as read give 67 for men and a rising figure for women, 67 mandatory, 60 early.

acts.title: National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version], 5755-1995
acts.identifier: ס״ח תשנ״ה, 210 (further publication at ס״ח תשנ״ה, 327); Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000198; Wikisource page חוק הביטוח הלאומי
acts.verified_how: Same single fetch as the Pensions/social security entry above: Wikisource page חוק הביטוח הלאומי, heading חוק הביטוח הלאומי [נוסח משולב], התשנ״ה–1995, metadata ס״ח תשנ״ה, 210 / ס״ח תשנ״ה, 327, Knesset lawitemid 2000198, consolidated version made 3 April 1995 (ג׳ בניסן התשנ״ה) in force 1 October 1995, amendment list running through תשפ״ו (2026).
acts.notes: Listed a second time under its second topic, as the instructions direct. On the benefits side it is the source of the non-means-tested and partly means-tested cash benefits: child allowance, disability, work-injury, maternity, unemployment benefit, long-term care and the reserve-service and bankruptcy branches. The residual means-tested safety net below it is the Income Support Law, and health cover is the National Health Insurance Law - the three together are the Israeli benefits system, and all three sit on the National Insurance Institute (המוסד לביטוח לאומי) as administrator.

acts.title: Income Support Law, 5741-1980
acts.identifier: ס״ח תשמ״א, 30 (further publication at ס״ח תשמ״א, 77); Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000193; Wikisource page חוק הבטחת הכנסה
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק הבטחת הכנסה, התשמ״א–1980; metadata gives ס״ח תשמ״א, 30 and 77 and Knesset lawitemid 2000193; most recent amendment noted תשפ״ה, 505 (2025). The commencement provision as printed brings the Law into force on ו׳ בטבת התשמ״ב (1 January 1982), with power for the Minister of Labour to bring provisions into force at later dates for particular categories of beneficiary.
acts.notes: This is the means-tested safety net (הבטחת הכנסה / השלמת הכנסה), administered by the National Insurance Institute, and it is the benefit a person with no other entitlement is actually governed by. The staged-commencement power in the commencement section means any historical point-in-time question before the mid-1980s needs the commencement orders checked, not just the Law. The benefit rates are set by reference to a percentage of the average wage and by regulation, not as fixed figures in the Law.

acts.title: National Health Insurance Law, 5754-1994
acts.identifier: ס״ח תשנ״ד, 156; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000111; Wikisource page חוק ביטוח בריאות ממלכתי
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק ביטוח בריאות ממלכתי, התשנ״ד–1994; metadata gives the Sefer HaChukim citation at page 156 of the התשנ״ד volume and Knesset lawitemid 2000111; original enactment 18 Tevet 5754 (January 1994). The amendment list runs through תשפ״ו, with one amendment on postal-service provisions noted as taking effect 31 December 2026, and the page carries several temporary provisions (הוראת שעה) with stated expiry dates.
acts.notes: In-kind benefit rather than cash: universal health cover, the health basket (סל הבריאות) in the Second Schedule, the sick funds (קופות החולים), and the health insurance contribution (דמי ביטוח בריאות) which is collected by the National Insurance Institute alongside national insurance contributions - which is why this Law also touches Personal tax/withholding in practice. in_force is 'yes', but note there is at least one amendment with a future commencement (31 December 2026) and several live הוראת שעה provisions: a point-in-time date is mandatory for any encoding. The health basket content is updated by order/regulation annually, not by amending the Law.

acts.title: Income Tax Ordinance [New Version]
acts.identifier: דמ״י תשכ״א, 120 (New Version, 5721-1961); early amendments at ס״ח תשכ״א, 47 and 122; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000944; Wikisource page פקודת מס הכנסה
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש]; metadata gives דמ״י תשכ״א, 120 plus ס״ח תשכ״א, 47 and 122, and Knesset lawitemid 2000944; the amendment list runs to תשפ״ו (2026) with multiple entries that year. On withholding, the structure read from the section headings is: Part X (חלק י׳) 'Payment and collection', Chapter One, 'Deductions on account of tax' (ניכויים על חשבון המס), with Sign א׳ deduction from dividend and interest (ss 164-166), Sign ב׳ deduction from salary and other income (s 167), Sign ג׳ deduction from a foreign resident (s 168), Sign ד׳ auxiliary powers (s 169), Sign ה׳ further provisions (s 170).
acts.notes: MANDATE-ERA ORDINANCE, not a Knesset Law: the parent instrument is the Mandate Income Tax Ordinance, and the operative text is the Hebrew New Version (נוסח חדש) published in דיני מדינת ישראל in 5721-1961, which is why the printed title carries [נוסח חדש] and no Hebrew year in the heading. It is nevertheless the central personal and corporate income tax statute and is amended by ordinary Knesset amending Laws (תיקון מס׳ ...), now past no. 270. On the question asked: withholding sits in BOTH places. The DUTY to deduct at source is imposed by the Ordinance itself, ss 164-170 (Part X, Chapter One), and s 164 is the general obligation with s 169 the auxiliary/regulation-making power; but the RATES, tables, thresholds, credit points and mechanics of deduction from salary are in regulations made under those sections, principally תקנות מס הכנסה (ניכוי ממשכורת ומשכר עבודה), התשנ״ג–1993 (ק״ת תשנ״ג, 408) - recorded in topic_gaps. An encoding of withholding that stops at the Ordinance will have the obligation but none of the arithmetic.

acts.title: Taxes (Collection) Ordinance
acts.identifier: חא״י כרך ב׳ פרק קל״ז, עמ׳ 1374; ע״ר 1937, תוס׳ 1, 104; ע״ר תש״ח, תוס׳ א׳, 1; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000886; Wikisource page פקודת המסים (גבייה)
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints פקודת המסים (גביה) with no Hebrew year; metadata gives חא״י כרך ב׳ פרק קל״ז, עמ׳ 1374, ע״ר 1937, תוס׳ 1, 104 and ע״ר תש״ח, תוס׳ א׳, 1, and Knesset lawitemid 2000886; most recent amendment noted תשפ״ב, 887 (2022) with a deferral notice at ק״ת תשפ״ג, 962. Section headings cover demand for payment, seizure of movable and immovable property, third-party garnishment, sale of seized property, and registration blocks, with modern amendments on electronic documents and service. No repeal notice appears on the page.
acts.notes: MANDATE-ERA ORDINANCE (commonly cited as the Taxes (Collection) Ordinance 1929; the printed consolidated heading carries no year, and the citations on the page are to חא״י and to the 1937 and 5708 Official Gazette, so no year is asserted here). Included because it, not the Income Tax Ordinance, supplies the enforced-collection machinery - demand, seizure, garnishee, sale - for income tax and most other taxes, including recovery of amounts a withholding agent failed to deduct or remit. It is the instrument a taxpayer in default is actually governed by. It is Ordinance-form but heavily modernised; the ק״ת תשפ״ג, 962 entry indicates a deferral of commencement of part of the 2022 amendment, so check commencement before relying on the latest text.

acts.title: Customs Tariff and Exemption Ordinance, 1937
acts.identifier: ע״ר 1937, תוס׳ 1, 183; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000972; Wikisource page פקודת תעריף המכס והפיטורין
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints פקודת תעריף המכס והפיטורין, 1937 (note the older spelling הפיטורין, not הפטורים); metadata gives ע״ר 1937, תוס׳ 1, 183 and Knesset lawitemid 2000972; last amendment noted תשמ״ו (1986); no repeal notice on the page (its own s 10 repeals the earlier customs duty ordinances). The charging provision is s 3(a): customs is imposed on imported goods at the rates prescribed in the Schedule (התוספת). Section 3(b) gives the Minister of Finance power on classification, including to implement international agreements, and s 5 gives power by order to add to or vary the Schedule. The Schedule itself is marked (הושמטה) - omitted - in the consolidated text.
acts.notes: THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT THAT ACTUALLY IMPOSES CUSTOMS DUTY. It is a Mandate-era Ordinance and it is the charging Act: s 3(a) levies duty on imported goods at the rates in the Schedule. The Schedule is omitted from the consolidated text because the operative tariff is now the Minister's order - צו תעריף המכס והפטורים ומס קנייה על טובין, התשע״ז–2017 - made under the order-making powers (s 5 of this Ordinance together with s 1 of the Customs Tariffs and Excise (Variation of Tariff) Law, 5709-1949). So the charge is statutory but the rates are subordinate: see topic_gaps. Do not mistake the Customs Ordinance [New Version] for the charging instrument - it is the administration and enforcement Ordinance.

acts.title: Customs Ordinance [New Version]
acts.identifier: דמ״י תשי״ז, 39 (New Version, 5717-1957); original at חא״י כרך א׳ פרק מ״ב, עמ׳ 493; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000883; Wikisource page פקודת המכס
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints פקודת המכס [נוסח חדש]; metadata gives the original at חא״י כרך א׳ פרק מ״ב, עמ׳ 493 and the New Version at דמ״י תשי״ז, 39, with Knesset lawitemid 2000883; most recent amendment noted תשפ״ו, 362 (2025/2026). Section headings cover administration and delegation, ports and entry, manifests and declarations, valuation of goods for duty, payment and collection, offences, forfeiture and administrative penalties, bonded warehouses, temporary entry, coastal trade and drawback. The Ordinance does not set duty rates; it refers to the tariff instrument (פקודת תעריף המכס והפטורים) for rates and exemptions.
acts.notes: MANDATE-ERA ORDINANCE in Hebrew New Version form (דמ״י תשי״ז, 39). This is the procedural and enforcement backbone of customs - import entry, declarations, customs valuation (ss 129-134א, which the VAT Law borrows), collection, seizure, forfeiture, smuggling offences, warehousing and drawback - but it does NOT impose the duty. The charge is in the 1937 Customs Tariff and Exemption Ordinance at the rates set by the 2017 tariff order. Both Ordinances are in force simultaneously and the similar names are a genuine trap.

acts.title: Customs Tariffs and Excise (Variation of Tariff) Law, 5709-1949
acts.title_he: חוק מסי מכס ובלו (שינוי תעריף), תש״ט–1949
acts.identifier: ס״ח תש״ט, 154; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2001077; Wikisource page חוק מסי מכס ובלו (שינוי תעריף)
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק מסי מכס ובלו (שינוי תעריף), תש״ט–1949 (note: printed תש״ט, without the leading ה of התש״ט); metadata gives ס״ח תש״ט, 154 and Knesset lawitemid 2001077, with later amendments at ס״ח תשי״ב, 264; תשט״ו, 159; תש״ך, 18; תשמ״ד, 161 - the most recent amendment noted is תשמ״ד (1984). Section headings read: s 1 power of the Minister of Finance by order to vary the customs tariff or excise; s 1א application to goods in a trader's stock; s 1ב application of Purchase Tax Law provisions to stock duty; s 2 Knesset Finance Committee oversight, with an increasing order lapsing after two months unless approved; s 2א regulation-making power.
acts.notes: A short Knesset enabling Law, unamended since 1984 but very much operative: it is the authority under which the Minister of Finance varies the customs tariff and excise by order, subject to Knesset Finance Committee approval for increases (two-month lapse rule in s 2). It does not itself impose duty and contains no rates. It matters because it, with s 5 of the 1937 Ordinance, is the vires for the current tariff order; a challenge to a rate is a challenge under this Law.

acts.title: Value Added Tax Law, 5736-1975
acts.identifier: ס״ח תשל״ו, 52; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2001068; Wikisource page חוק מס ערך מוסף
acts.verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק מס ערך מוסף, תשל״ו–1975; metadata gives the Sefer HaChukim citation at page 52 of the תשל״ו volume and Knesset lawitemid 2001068; most recent amendment noted תשפ״ו, 405 (2026). On import: s 2 imposes VAT on a transaction in Israel and on the import of goods (יבוא טובין) at the rate set by the Minister of Finance; s 11(א) values imported goods by reference to the customs valuation provisions of the Customs Ordinance (ss 129 to 134א), plus the customs duty and any other tax or levy applying on the import; s 26(א) fixes the time the tax on import becomes chargeable.
acts.notes: Included because it bears directly on import duties, but it is NOT the customs charging instrument: VAT on import is a separate tax, imposed by s 2 of this Law, calculated on a base that includes the customs duty (s 11(א)) and that borrows the Customs Ordinance valuation rules (ss 129-134א). At the border a single import therefore attracts up to three charges under three different instruments: customs duty (1937 Ordinance at the 2017 tariff order rates), purchase tax (Purchase Tax (Goods and Services) Law, 5712-1952, with rates in the same 2017 order), and VAT (this Law). The VAT rate itself is set by order of the Minister of Finance under s 2, not in the Law, so the standard rate cannot be read off the statute.

topic_gaps.reason: The rates of customs duty, purchase tax and the exemptions are not in any statute. They are in subordinate legislation: צו תעריף המכס והפטורים ומס קנייה על טובין, התשע״ז–2017 (Customs Tariff and Exemptions and Purchase Tax on Goods Order, 5777-2017), made under the order-making power in s 5 of the 1937 Customs Tariff and Exemption Ordinance together with s 1 of the Customs Tariffs and Excise (Variation of Tariff) Law, 5709-1949. Verified by fetching the Hebrew Wikisource page צו תעריף המכס והפטורים ומס קנייה על טובין: the page exists but is a stub gateway - it carries the instrument's name and year, states that the order is published on the Tax Authority website (מפורסם באתר רשות המסים) and links to the Customs Authority classification query system, and does NOT reproduce the rate schedules. It was last edited 25 August 2024. There is thus no consolidated free text of the operative tariff on Wikisource, and the tariff is amended by further orders frequently. Anyone encoding Israeli customs must take the schedule from the Tax Authority tariff system, and must treat the statute layer (1937 Ordinance s 3(a) charge + 1949 Law vires + Customs Ordinance [New Version] machinery) as separate from the rate layer. The 1937 Ordinance's own Schedule is marked (הושמטה) in the consolidated text for exactly this reason.

The withholding DUTY is statutory - Income Tax Ordinance [New Version] ss 164-170 (Part X, Chapter One, ניכויים על חשבון המס), verified from the section headings on the Wikisource page - but the operative withholding mechanics are regulatory. The deduction tables, rates, thresholds, credit points, treatment of multiple employers and the employer's reporting and remittance duties sit in תקנות מס הכנסה (ניכוי ממשכורת ומשכר עבודה), התשנ״ג–1993 (ק״ת תשנ״ג, 408), verified as existing on Hebrew Wikisource by fetching that page, with parallel regulations for deduction from payments to a foreign resident, from interest and dividend, and from payments for services and assets. These are regulations (תקנות), not Acts, so they are recorded here rather than in the acts list. Practical consequence: the answer to 'does withholding sit in the Ordinance or in regulations' is BOTH, and an encoding needs the regulations to compute anything.

No statute gap in the three Acts listed, but one structural gap worth recording: compulsory occupational pension coverage for employees is imposed by a general extension order (צו הרחבה) of a collective agreement under the Collective Agreements Law, 5717-1957, not by any statute. The Supervision of Financial Services (Provident Funds) Law, 5765-2005 regulates the funds; it does not compel enrolment. Not verified by fetch here because it falls outside the four topics assigned (it is a labour-law instrument), and it is flagged rather than indexed.
